title: Boris frontmatter grammar (schema v1)
description: JSON view of the closed author-facing frontmatter grammar (docs/contracts/frontmatter.md). Frontmatter source is not JSON: tools convert the parsed field set to this object shape before validating. Keys absent from the source are null. The key set is closed — additionalProperties:false is normative, matching the product parser's unknown-key rejection. Length bounds: JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points, while the product parser's limits are UTF-8 bytes (see frontmatter.md), so for multibyte content this schema is a looser pre-check and the parser stays normative. published_at: the pattern checks shape only; the parser additionally requires a real Gregorian calendar date (rss_date.parse), which JSON Schema cannot express.
